name: nested-svg-sub-artboard
story: A full-frame election bumper card with the channel's ident file placed on it and embedded, so Illustrator writes the ident as a nested <svg> with its own 720x256 viewBox scaled to 360x128 at 1440,72 while the card's own headline and timestamp stay in the outer coordinate space.
idioms: a nested <svg x="1440px" y="72px" width="360px" height="128px" viewBox="0 0 720 256" overflow="visible"> inside the root svg - a 0.5x sub-coordinate system
Generator comment naming the SVG Export Plug-In build
version="1.1" id="Layer_1" x="0px" y="0px" and style="enable-background:new 0 0 1920 1080;" on the root
xml:space="preserve" on both the root and the placed sub-artboard
the .stN internal stylesheet, one class per property, applied as class="st2 st4 st6"
matrix(1 0 0 1 tx ty) on every <text> instead of x/y attributes
PostScript face names in font-family ('Archivo-Bold', 'Inter-Medium') and unitless letter-spacing:4
tab indentation with the root's attribute continuation line indented one tab
whyThisMatters: A placed sub-artboard is on the artboard and paints, so the promise says its text binds like any other - but a walker that stops at the first <svg>, or a fitter that measures the ident's lines in root units, either silently drops two operator fields or budgets them at twice their real width and lets NEWS 24 run straight out of its ident block.
